svg.title: LitVM V2 architecture
svg.desc: Arbitrum Orbit and Nitro execution; Ethereum settlement. Charms connects native LTC to zkLTC on Ethereum; Arbitrum connects Ethereum to LitVM. Succinct proving technology, Espresso sequencing, and Zeeve infrastructure migration. Litecoin secures native LTC ownership. Availability depends on released integrations.

g.aria-label: V2 design; see Network Status for availability.
